description: Sri Lanka Railways - Revision of Railway Fares
reasoning: This gazette contains rules and regulations made by the Minister of Transport under the Railways Ordinance, specifically amending fares for passenger transport, goods conveyance, petroleum products, and mail services. It establishes new regulatory frameworks for railway operations, including detailed fare structures, minimum charges, and demurrage rules. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
